title: 第3章 她温柔？才怪！
content_zh:
走出夏紫萱的办公室，漫步在校园内的一条林荫小道上，叶寒的脸色有些怪异。

就在前一刻，他的脑中突然多出了一些东西，应该是这个身体原主人的一部分记忆。

记忆中，自己在这个世界里有个家庭，家中有父母兄妹，另外还有一个很要好的朋友，叫做叶壮，除此之外，就是一些稀奇古怪的事情。

对叶寒来说，突然多出来的这部分记忆让他感到非常欣喜，毕竟有了这些记忆的融入，自己在这个世界里总算不是一无所知了。

刚刚走出学校大门，就听到有人在叫喊自己，叶寒扭头看去，只见校门右侧路边的一株大树下，窜出一个和自己年龄相仿的少年。

那少年比叶寒还要高出半个头，白胖白胖的，慈眉善目，一副憨厚模样，看向叶寒的眼光里充满了惊喜和关切。

“你……叶……叶壮？”看到这少年，叶寒脑中顿时涌出了许多有关他的讯息，一种亲切感油然而生，哈哈一笑，大步走过去，抬起拳头在少年胸口捶了一拳，道：“你小子，怎么还没回家？蹲在这里干什么？”

记忆中，这个貌似憨厚、实则和自己一副德性的少年，就是自己的同班同学兼铁哥们叶壮，这家伙不但和自己同班同姓，而且还是从小一起玩到大的邻居，两人不是亲兄弟，感情却胜似亲兄弟。

两人从幼儿园起就是同学，到了小学、中学，依然还是同学，每天一起上学、一起回家，另外还在一起抽过烟、一起喝过酒、一起泡过妞、一起挨过打，就连学习成绩都是一样的差。

“等你呗！”叶壮挠了挠头，咧嘴一笑，露出一排白牙，上下打量了几眼叶寒，突然伸手在他肩头拍了一下，叹道：“兄弟，你受苦了！”

叶壮道：“夏老师把你叫去办公室，肯定把你喷了个狗血淋头吧？这还不苦？”

“没有的事！”叶寒笑道：“夏老师只是很温柔的对我进行了一番劝导，然后就放我走了。”

“她温柔？才怪！”叶壮哪里肯信？撇嘴道：“那只母老虎，今天你可把她给气的不轻，她不用教尺打你的手心都是轻的……唉，以后在她面前，你最好老实一点！走啦，回家一起写作业去！”

两兄弟勾肩搭背，有说有笑的向前走去。

秋季昼短夜长，天黑的早，再加上学校放学的晚，叶寒又被班主任夏紫萱留了一段时间，因此两人走出校园时，天色已经黯淡下来，街道两侧的路灯渐次亮起，整座城市一片通明。

两人背着书包，经过学校西侧数百米外的一个小胡同时，四、五个黑影突然从胡同里冲出，那些黑影口中骂骂咧咧的，推推搡搡间，硬是把叶寒、叶壮两人带到了胡同深处。

借着胡同里一盏黄昏路灯，可以看清那几个黑影原来是几个学生，和叶寒两人年龄差不多，几个学生一样都背着书包，身上穿的也是一中的校服，流里流气的模样，一看就知道是些校园小混子。

看到这几个混混学生，叶寒倒没什么反应，叶壮却吓的脸色发白，目光停留在其中一个头发微卷、嘴里叼着半根香烟的学生身上，颤声道：“豹……豹哥，你……你们要干什么？”

“干什么？”那叫豹哥的学生很潇洒的甩了甩一头卷毛，弹了下烟灰，然后手指向叶寒两人勾了勾，冷笑道：“老规矩，保护费！

叶壮大声道：“保护费我们上周已经交过了！”

豹哥翻了下眼皮，道：“上周是上周的，这周还得交！”

“不是吧。”叶壮哭丧着脸道：“以前不都是一月一交的么？”

豹哥朝地上啐了一口，道：“尼玛，时代在变，我们也要与时俱进！”

“那……那还要交多少啊？”叶壮两人和这帮校园混混打交道已经不是一天两天了，知道这些家伙一个比一个心狠，如果不老实交钱，就得被打，在此之前，他和叶寒被打的可不止一次两次了。

豹哥伸出一根手指头，道：“十块！”

“啊？不是五块么？以前都是五块的！”叶壮像是被踩了尾巴的猫，失声大叫起来，他们家的经济条件虽然比叶寒要好不少，但父母每天也只给一块、两块的零花钱，一下子拿出十块，他不心疼才怪。

豹哥瞪眼道：“妈地，叫什么叫，再叫抽的你嘴巴开花！你不知道现在物价上涨的厉害么？我们的保护费当然也要涨！我们吃江湖饭的，今天要罩这个，明天要罩那个，天天忙的要死，连学习都没多少功夫，你当我们容易么？少废话，你们两个，一人十块钱！”

叶壮看了叶寒一眼，咬了咬牙，道：“豹哥，叶寒家里穷，真拿不出那么多钱，我们两个一起交十五块怎么样？”

“不行！”豹哥断然拒绝，恶狠狠的威胁道：“拿不出就去偷去抢，我管你们用什么办法！反正不交钱，以后见你们一次打一次！”

叶壮叹了口气，把手伸进自己衣兜里，他身上今天还真带了二十多块钱，原本是准备明天买漫画书看的，看来这次是保不住了，他也知道叶寒没钱，所以叶寒的保护费自己还得替他出，不然他就会被打，谁叫两人是好兄弟呢，总不能见死不救吧？

进入胡同之后，叶寒就一直冷眼旁观，见几个中学生居然在学校附近干起了打家劫舍的勾当，不由又好气又好笑，又见叶壮准备掏钱交什么“保护费”，立即伸手拦住，

“叶寒，你……”叶壮看了叶寒一眼，不明白他什么意思。

“几个小混混，理他们干什么？咱们走！”叶寒鄙夷的看了一眼豹哥等人，拉着叶壮转身就走。

“靠！反了天了！”豹哥大怒，弹掉手中烟头，向身边一名小混混使了个眼色，那小混混怪叫一声，追上叶寒，一拳轰向他后背。

“叶寒小心！”叶壮惊叫一声，身体斜冲，就要替叶寒去挡那小混混的拳头，他身体比叶寒强壮得多，以前两人每次放学被打，都是他用身体护着叶寒。

叶寒嘴角噙着冷笑，手上微微用力，便将叶壮拉到了一边，等到那小混混冲到近前时，抬腿一个漂亮的侧踢，将那小混混远远踢飞出去，那小混混身体落地后，贴着地面又倒滑出几米远，趴在地上哼哼唧唧半天爬不起来。

开玩笑，堂堂“仙医门”首席大弟子，曾经斩杀过无数妖邪的渡劫期强者，虽说如今灵魂夺舍重生在一个身体孱弱的学生身上，远不复当年神勇，但瘦死的骆驼比马大，最基本的自护能力还是有的，要是连一个小屁孩儿都对付不了，那还不如去死！

“我靠……”见叶寒犹如超人附体，战力值爆增，竟一脚踹飞了那个平时很能打的小混混，叶壮吓了一大跳，难以置信的看着叶寒，眼珠子几乎瞪掉到地上。

豹哥等人纵横一中校园，无人敢惹，以前他们向叶寒、叶壮两人收取“保护费”时，两人表现的都是战战兢兢，没想到这次叶寒像是吃了熊心豹子胆，不但拒交“保护费”，还敢反抗打人，豹哥等人见状，顿时就炸了窝。
content_en:
Walking out of Xia Zixuan's office and walking along a tree-lined path on campus, Ye Han had a strange look on his face.

Just a moment ago, something suddenly appeared in his mind, which should be part of the memory of the original owner of this body.

In his memory, he had a family in this world, with parents, siblings, and a very good friend named Ye Zhuang. Other than that, there were some weird things.

For Ye Han, the sudden extra memory made him feel very happy. After all, with the integration of these memories, he finally knew nothing about this world.

As soon as he walked out of the school gate, he heard someone calling him. Ye Han turned around and saw a young man about his own age emerging from under a big tree on the road to the right of the school gate.

The young man was half a head taller than Ye Han. He was fair and plump, with kind eyebrows and kind eyes. He had a simple and honest look. His eyes when he looked at Ye Han were full of surprise and concern.

"You...Ye...Ye Zhuang?" Seeing this young man, Ye Han suddenly had a lot of information about him in his mind, and a sense of intimacy arose spontaneously. He laughed, strode over, raised his fist and punched the young man in the chest, and said: "You kid, why haven't you gone home yet? What are you doing squatting here?"

In my memory, this young man who seemed honest and honest, but actually had the same moral character as him, was his classmate and best friend Ye Zhuang. Not only did this guy share the same surname as his classmate, but he was also a neighbor who had played together since childhood. The two were not real brothers, but their relationship was better than that of real brothers.

The two have been classmates since kindergarten, and they are still classmates in elementary and middle schools. They go to school together and go home together every day. In addition, they smoke together, drink together, pick up girls together, and get beaten together. Even their academic performance is the same.

"Waiting for you!" Ye Zhuang scratched his head, grinned, showing a row of white teeth, looked at Ye Han up and down for a few times, suddenly reached out and patted him on the shoulder, and sighed: "Brother, you have suffered!"

Ye Zhuang said: "When Teacher Xia called you to the office, he must have sprayed you bloody, right? Isn't this bitter?"

"It's nothing!" Ye Han said with a smile: "Teacher Xia just gave me some gentle persuasion, and then let me go."

"She's gentle? That's weird!" How could Ye Zhuang believe that?He curled his lips and said: "That tigress, you made her very angry today. She doesn't need a ruler to hit your palm lightly... Sigh, you'd better be more honest in front of her from now on! Let's go home and do homework together!"

The two brothers put their arms around each other and walked forward, talking and laughing.

In autumn, the days are short and the nights are long, and it gets dark early. In addition, school ends late, and Ye Han is kept by his class teacher Xia Zixuan for a while. Therefore, when the two of them walked out of the campus, the sky had darkened, and the street lights on both sides of the street gradually lit up, making the whole city bright.

The two of them were carrying their schoolbags and passing through a small alley a few hundred meters away on the west side of the school. Four or five black figures suddenly rushed out of the alley. The shadows were cursing and pushing and shoving, forcing Ye Han and Ye Zhuang to the depths of the alley.

Through a street lamp at dusk in the alley, one could clearly see that the dark figures turned out to be several students, who were about the same age as Ye Han. The students all carried schoolbags and were also wearing the uniforms of No. 1 Middle School. They looked arrogant, and one could tell at a glance that they were some campus gangsters.

Seeing these gangster students, Ye Han didn't react at all, but Ye Zhuang's face turned pale with fright. His eyes stayed on one of the students with slightly curly hair and half a cigarette in his mouth, and said in a trembling voice: "Brother Bao... Brother Bao, you... what are you going to do?"

"What are you doing?" The student named Brother Bao shook his curly hair coolly, flicked the ashes of his cigarette, then pointed at Ye Han and the two of them, and sneered: "Old rules, protection money!

Ye Qiang said loudly: "We paid the protection fee last week!"

Brother Bao rolled his eyelids and said: "Last week was last week, and I have to pay it this week!"

"No."Ye Zhuang said with a sad face: "Didn't we always pay once a month in the past?"

Brother Bao spat on the ground and said: "Nima, times are changing, and we must also keep pace with the times!"

"Then... how much more do you have to pay?"Ye Zhuang has been dealing with these gangs of campus gangsters for more than a day or two. They know that each of these guys is more cruel than the last. If you don't pay the money honestly, you will be beaten. Before this, he and Ye Han were beaten more than once or twice.

Brother Bao stretched out a finger and said: "Ten yuan!"

"ah?Isn't it five yuan?It used to be five yuan!"Ye Zhuang screamed like a cat whose tail had been stepped on. Although their family's economic conditions were much better than Ye Han's, their parents only gave them one or two yuan of pocket money every day. It was strange that he didn't feel bad if they took out ten yuan at once.

Brother Bao glared and said: "Damn it, what do you call it? If you call it again, your mouth will burst into tears!Don’t you know how much prices are rising now?Of course our protection fees will also increase!We, the gangsters, have to protect this today and that tomorrow. We are so busy every day that we don’t even have much time to study. Is it easy for you to think of us?Stop talking nonsense, you two, ten yuan each!"

Ye Zhuang glanced at Ye Han, gritted his teeth and said, "Brother Bao, Ye Han's family is poor and he really can't afford that much money. How about we pay fifteen yuan together?"

"no!Brother Bao flatly refused and threatened viciously: "If you can't get it out, just steal it and rob it. I don't care what you do!"Anyway, if you don’t pay, I’ll see you every time I fight!"

Ye Zhuang sighed and put his hand into his pocket. He actually brought more than 20 yuan with him today. He originally planned to buy comic books to read tomorrow. It seems that he can't save it this time. He also knows that Ye Han has no money, so he has to pay for Ye Han's protection money, otherwise he will be beaten. Who said the two are good brothers? They can't just die without saving him, right?

After entering the alley, Ye Han watched with cold eyes. When he saw a few middle school students actually robbing houses and houses near the school, he couldn't help but feel angry and funny. When he saw Ye Zhuang was about to pay some "protection fee", he immediately stretched out his hand to stop them.

"Ye Han, you..." Ye Zhuang glanced at Ye Han, not understanding what he meant.

"Those little gangsters, what are you doing with them?Let's go!"Ye Han glanced at Brother Bao and others with disdain, pulled Ye Zhuang and turned around to leave.

"Fuck!This is outrageous!"Brother Bao was furious, flicked the cigarette butt in his hand, and winked at a young gangster beside him. The young gangster let out a strange scream, chased after Ye Han, and punched him in the back.

"Ye Han, be careful!"Ye Zhuang screamed in alarm and rushed forward, trying to block the gangster's fist for Ye Han. He was much stronger than Ye Han. In the past, every time the two of them were beaten after school, he used his body to protect Ye Han.

Ye Han sneered at the corner of his mouth, and with a little force on his hands, he pulled Ye Zhuang aside. When the little gangster rushed forward, he raised his leg and gave a beautiful side kick, kicking the little gangster far away. After the little gangster's body landed, he slid back a few meters away from the ground. He lay on the ground groaning and couldn't get up for a long time.

Just kidding, the chief disciple of the dignified "Immortal Medical Sect" once killed countless demons and powerful men in the tribulation period. Although his soul is now reborn in a weak student, he is far from the bravery he once was. But a skinny camel is bigger than a horse, and he still has the most basic self-protection ability. If you can't even deal with a little kid, then you might as well die!

"Holy shit..." Seeing that Ye Han was possessed by a superman, his combat power increased dramatically, and he actually kicked away the gangster who was usually very good at fighting. Ye Zhuang was startled, and looked at Ye Han in disbelief, his eyes almost falling to the ground.

Brother Bao and others roamed the campus of No. 1 Middle School, and no one dared to offend them. When they collected "protection fees" from Ye Han and Ye Zhuang in the past, both of them acted with trepidation. Unexpectedly, this time Ye Han seemed to have taken advantage of him. Not only did he refuse to pay the "protection fee", but he also dared to resist and beat people. Brother Bao and others immediately exploded when they saw this.
